rule_candidates.then: central next-day variance expectation = log-HAR x 0.84 relative to the average residual; stops and risk keep the unshrunk risk sigma (R-VOL-2)

rule_candidates.review: register as a forward hypothesis; demote if the effect on dates after 2026-11-12 changes sign or falls below half; it contradicts R-VOL-7, R-VOL-25 (no BTC vol spillover beyond own HAR), which stay in force until a forward test confirms this
